metadata.normalized_value: query-driven Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (CS-TGN) that combines local query-dependent structure and global graph embedding per snapshot, then uses a GRU cell with contextual attention to learn dynamics of interactions and update node embeddings over time
metadata.evidence: In this paper, we propose a query-driven Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (CS-TGN) that can capture flexible community structures by learning from the ground-truth communities in a data-driven manner. CS-TGN first combines the local query-dependent structure and the global graph embedding in each snapshot of the network and then uses a GRU cell with contextual attention to learn the dynamics of interactions and update node embeddings over time.
metadata.reason: Describes the core method/architecture, useful for understanding and reuse.
